title: Revelation Bible Quiz - Chapter 16
description: Ten questions on Revelation 16: the seven bowls of the wrath of God poured out on the earth.

questions.text: What did the loud voice out of the temple tell the seven angels to do?
questions.explanation: The loud voice said, “Go and pour out the seven bowls of the wrath of God on the earth!”

answers.text: Sound their seven trumpets
Seal the servants of God on their foreheads
Pour out the seven bowls of the wrath of God on the earth
Gather the clusters of the vine of the earth

questions.text: What happened to the people who had the mark of the beast when the first bowl was poured out?
questions.explanation: The first angel poured out his bowl into the earth, and it became a harmful and evil sore on the people who had the mark of the beast and who worshiped his image.

answers.text: They were scorched with great heat
They gnawed their tongues in the dark
They were killed by great hailstones
They got a harmful and evil sore

questions.text: What happened to the sea when the second bowl was poured out?
questions.explanation: The sea became blood as of a dead man, and every living thing in the sea died.

answers.text: One third of it became blood
It became blood as of a dead man
It was dried up completely
It became a sea of glass

questions.text: What happened when the fourth bowl was poured out on the sun?
questions.explanation: It was given to the sun to scorch men with fire, and people were scorched with great heat and blasphemed the name of God.

answers.text: People were scorched with great heat
The sun became black as sackcloth
One third of the sun was darkened
The sun stopped shining for half an hour

questions.text: What happened when the fifth bowl was poured out on the throne of the beast?
questions.explanation: His kingdom was darkened, and they gnawed their tongues because of the pain.

answers.text: His throne was thrown into the sea
His fatal wound was healed
His image was broken in pieces
His kingdom was darkened

questions.text: What happened to the great river Euphrates when the sixth bowl was poured out?
questions.explanation: Its water was dried up, so that the way might be prepared for the kings that come from the sunrise.

answers.text: Its water became blood
Its water was dried up
Its water became bitter as wormwood
Four angels bound there were freed

questions.text: What came out of the mouths of the dragon, the beast and the false prophet?
questions.explanation: John saw three unclean spirits, something like frogs, coming out of their mouths.

answers.text: Three unclean spirits like frogs
Fire, smoke and sulfur
A river of water like a flood
Hail mixed with fire and blood

questions.text: What is the name of the place where the kings were gathered together?
questions.explanation: He gathered them together into the place which is called in Hebrew, “Megiddo”.

answers.text: Babylon
Sodom
Megiddo
Mount Zion

questions.text: What did the loud voice from the throne say when the seventh bowl was poured out into the air?
questions.explanation: A loud voice came out of the temple of heaven, from the throne, saying, “It is done!”

answers.text: “Woe! Woe! Woe!”
“Come and see!”
“Who is able to stand?”
“It is done!”

questions.text: How heavy were the hailstones that came down out of the sky on people?
questions.explanation: Great hailstones, about the weight of a talent, came down out of the sky on people, and people blasphemed God because of the plague of the hail.

answers.text: About the weight of a denarius
About the weight of a talent
About the weight of a millstone
About the weight of a choenix of wheat
